answer: Think of Proof of unique wire transfer corridor record as a toll booth: transfers on one corridor, monthly, for three years, so the marble of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while transfers on one corridor, monthly, for three years takes days to arrange for each new name; the ember is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the bridge cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
